svg.text: Prompt / memory-injection & jailbreak scanning as a service. SQS splits a thin ingest API from scanner workers that autoscale on queue depth.
VPC · 2 public subnets in 2 AZs · no NAT gateway
DB credentials injected at task start
Open the web app over HTTPS
API stores the prompt in S3
API sends {job_id, s3_key} to SQS, returns 202
Worker fetches the prompt and scans it
Verdict saved in RDS, message deleted
F1–F6 / N1–N6 = design-doc requirements met by that service
